newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec govt sees Domtar stake sale distant.
newsitem.headline: Quebec govt sees Domtar stake sale distant.

text.p: The Quebec government is still analyzing the possibility of selling its 23 percent holding in Domtar Inc and said it was not connected with the hectic activity in the shares on Thursday.
"It's still under analysis," said Le Societe Generale de Financement spokesman Eric Meunier.
"It's going to take a while before we do proceed with the selling of the shares," he added.
Domtar was up 0.10 on the Toronto Stock Exchange at 11.30 in turnover of 4.29 million shares, including a 4.21 million share block crossed by Gordon Capital Corp late morning.
Traders attributed the activity to Domtar's redemption of its convertible debentures, announced August 19.
The Quebec government in February hired a financial adviser to examine the possibility of the stake sale.
